prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results with an option to licence, which is our standard position for joint projects

content.text: The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence. I'd prefer company_owns, but I can compromise to uni_owns_option_to_assign which gives us a path to full ownership. I'll trade on exclusivity months (accept 12) to get the stronger IP option (option_to_assign).
